questions.stem: Two bodies are having kinetic energies in the ratio $16: 9$. If they have same linear momentum, the ratio of their masses respectively is:
questions.solution: Using $K=p^2/(2m)$, equal momenta imply that kinetic energy is inversely proportional to mass. Thus $m_1/m_2=K_2/K_1=9/16$.
